subjects.label: Programming the skill conditions
subjects.description: The game read as programming: gambits, if statements, flowcharts, Scratch, macros, code golf and debugging, and who that suits; general praise of the mechanics without the programming framing does not belong here.

subjects.label: Combos and infinite scaling
subjects.description: Finding synergies and building loops that scale without a cap, one-turn kills, no-damage clears and numbers exploding; the feel of the game or its difficulty in general does not belong here.

subjects.label: Mama and the turn limit
subjects.description: The parent who chases the runaway child and the distance from her that acts as the run's turn limit, whether as a mechanic or as the story players read into it; other resources and enemies do not belong here.

subjects.label: Free retries and battle preview
subjects.description: Seeing the predicted outcome before a fight, stepping through it, and redoing any battle without penalty until it works, including whether that safety net makes things too easy; saving a run for later does not belong here.

subjects.label: Challenge levels and NG+
subjects.description: The numbered challenge levels, Hard mode, the extra stages, the bonus boss and how the demands change at level five; the ordinary first clear and general difficulty remarks do not belong here.

subjects.label: Bosses that counter builds
subjects.description: Particular bosses such as the Golem or the Crystal and how their rules break or demand a rearranged build; ordinary enemies and the run's overall difficulty do not belong here.

subjects.label: Endless mode request
subjects.description: Wanting an endless or infinite stage so a finished build can keep going after the run ends; other content wishes such as more characters do not belong here.

subjects.label: Character roster
subjects.description: How many playable characters there are, the single unlock, and wanting more of them; wishes for other kinds of content do not belong here.

subjects.label: Saving mid-run
subjects.description: Wanting to suspend a run and resume it later, leaving the game open because you cannot, and carrying a save between machines; retrying a battle does not belong here.

subjects.label: Battle log and results screen
subjects.description: Wanting a readable battle log and a results screen that shows which skills fired and how the run went; other interface wishes do not belong here.

subjects.label: The demo
subjects.description: Having played the demo before buying, how the full game compares with it, and telling others to try it first; watching someone else play does not belong here.

subjects.label: Low-stress casual pace
subjects.description: Short runs played briskly as a breather or beside a video, with nothing to think about but the build; losing sleep because you could not stop does not belong here.
